name: MTS
desc: The public web app and backend for MTS, a livestreamed news and talk show on X. A Cloudflare Worker owns the database, signs JWTs for the admin UI, proxies the X live-broadcast API, mirrors a Discord channel into the home-page chat, and runs crons that refresh feeds and the show calendar.

name: 877UNMPLYD
desc: Site and data platform for a live call-in show about unemployment. A Worker ingests seven public datasets into D1 each week, feeding an interactive map of 72 cities that ranks real median wage — wages divided by local price parity — so Oklahoma City outranks Los Angeles.

name: Uncertainty Labs
desc: Bayesian state-space models that estimate what prices are actually worth under uncertainty, using microstructure — volume, spread, orderbook depth — to quantify observation noise. First product is Polyscope: a Student-t state-space model on Polymarket orderbooks producing three-day probabilistic forecasts, backed by a Rust implementation of the WALNUTS sampler.

name: CONDITIONAL
desc: An AI-native prediction market platform built on the thesis that information buyers, not bettors, should subsidize liquidity — and that prices must stay private, since public signals are worthless to sophisticated buyers. Eleven subsystems spanning forecasting agents, a trusted-execution layer, and private and public research intake.

name: The Spread
desc: A comprehensive prediction market news and analysis platform. Aggregates markets, odds movements, and trading activity across prediction market platforms into a single destination.

name: Polygrapher
desc: Newsletter automation tool built for Polymarket. Pulls relevant markets and trades via APIs, lets editors customize content, optimizes HTML for email clients (Dub links, Cloudinary, minification). Goes out to 200k+ subscribers and drove $1M+ in new deposits in ~1 month.

name: Indexr
desc: Real-time searchable index of Polymarket markets and large trades. Syncs data every 5 minutes, flags whale traders (>$5K trades), tracks win rates, and filters by liquidity. Surfaces NewWhale, WinningTrader, and Contrarian behavioral tags.

name: SafeChoices
desc: Research on whether 'safe' prediction market bets (90%+ probability) can beat Treasury rates. Includes Polymarket API data collection, probability calibration analysis across confidence bands, and Monte Carlo simulations modeling single-fund, threshold, and multi-fund portfolio strategies. Dataset published on Kaggle.

name: RushTracker
desc: A rush management system for Greek life organizations. Tracks prospective members through the rush process with a full frontend and backend.

name: Inside the UFO Release
desc: An MTS drop over war.gov's first UFO/UAP release: 161 declassified records from the FBI, NASA, and the Departments of War and State, geocoded onto an interactive globe and indexed for full-text search.

name: Search Every Exhibit
desc: An MTS drop offering semantic search across all 199 trial-admitted exhibits in OpenAI v. Musk — emails, journal pages, contracts, screenshots — each rendered in a form-factor viewer that matches the original document.

name: Inside the AI Grey Market
desc: An MTS drop tracing 1,000 ex-employee shares through three layers of SPVs to 47 retail-accredited LPs at a 39 percent cumulative premium — nine self-paced steps ending at the announcement that voided every unauthorized secondary transfer.

name: How the Smart Money Reads AI
desc: An MTS drop built on every 13F-HR filing since mid-2023 from 45 curated funds, joined to Form 4 insider flow and adjusted-close prices, surfacing rotation and consensus calls quarter by quarter.

name: Why AI's Water Problem Is Overblown
desc: An MTS drop auditing the viral "500 mL per query" figure, which conflated per-conversation with per-prompt on stale 2022 hardware. A bottom-up accounting lands at roughly 3 mL — about a sip — and puts a single hamburger at two million prompts.
